notes: Kansas law excludes FLSA-covered employment (DOL table); federal rules apply to most retail.
No state meal-period requirement for adults in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (K.S.A. 38-603): Kansas under-16 limits (8 h/40 h, 10 p.m. before school days) are looser than federal 3 h/18 h/7 p.m.; federal.json still applies. No Kansas hour limits for 16-17. School-week rule enforces 10 p.m. every night (stricter on Fri/Sat).

rules.summary: Kansas's basic minimum wage is $7.25 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)

rules.summary: Children under 16 in mercantile, hotel or restaurant jobs may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, not before 7 a.m. or after 10 p.m. on evenings before a school day.

citation.title: K.S.A. 38-603 — Children under 16, employment
citation.excerpt: shall be employed before 7 a.m., or after 10 p.m., except on any evening that does not precede a school day, nor more than eight (8) hours in any one calendar day, nor more than forty (40) hours
